vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2026-0235
vulnerability.description: rkyv: insufficient archive validation can cause out-of-bounds reads in archives containing Rc/Arc

statements.impact_statement: rkyv 0.7 appears in Cargo.lock only as an optional dependency of rust_decimal whose feature this workspace never enables. `cargo tree -i rkyv` prints 'nothing to print': no crate depends on it and it is never compiled into any artifact. The lockfile records optional dependencies regardless. Re-check if rust_decimal's `rkyv` feature is ever turned on.
